assumptions: Stop-sign presence and 'approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection' cannot be seen by the camera, so every tracked vehicle is checked as if subject to the rule.

The limit line is assumed marked at this location so the 'if marked' branch applies; the 'otherwise before entering the crosswalk' and 'entrance to the intersecting roadway' branches are omitted because no crosswalk or entrance geometry is provided.
'Stop at a limit line' is interpreted as coming to a complete stop inside stop_zone, defined as the last 10 metres before the marked STOP limit line, before crossing stop_line.
The statute states 'shall stop' with no hold duration, so a minimum continuously-stopped dwell of 1000 ms is assumed to count as a stop.
'Stop' is interpreted as only while stopped/still, encoded as max_speed 0.05, although the statute states no speed threshold.
Inbound travel (+y, from y<0.6 towards y>0.6) is encoded as direction to_right per line metadata.
Anchor center is used because boxes are top-down vehicles whose centre is metric position, while bottom_center is only the downstream AABB edge per line notes.
Objects that never cross the stop line inbound vacuously pass, per 'every X must do A before B' idiom.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped still inside the approach waiting zone.

Statute says 'shall stop' with no duration; 1000 ms is assumed as the minimum continuously-inside stopped interval to count as a stop.
Statute says 'shall stop' without a stillness threshold; 0.05 is assumed to mean only while stopped/still.
Boxes are top-down vehicles whose centre is metric position while bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not wheels, so centre is the point zones and lines were drawn for.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
